verdict.rationale: New Relic is a SaaS observability platform with AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a control that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. Related items, such as the Diagnostics CLI not transmitting data by default and disabling default log collection, are adjacent data-collection controls, not AI-training opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
